fix(duckdb): read the UNIFORM seed set by the Databricks parser (#8519)

The Databricks parser stores the third UNIFORM argument in exp.Uniform's
seed slot, while DuckDBGenerator.uniform_sql read only gen. A Databricks
UNIFORM written to DuckDB therefore emitted HASH with no argument and
dropped the seed, so two different seeds produced identical SQL.

Normalise seed into the gen slot the way SnowflakeGenerator.uniform_sql
already does. The resulting DuckDB output now matches the renderings
tests/dialects/test_snowflake.py already asserts for the equivalent
Snowflake inputs. Snowflake inputs are unchanged.
